evals.prompt: Audit our paid ads and tell me what to scale.
evals.expected_output: Checks tracking, unit economics, structure, audience, creative, landing page, and approval before recommending spend changes.

evals.prompt: Calculate whether this campaign is profitable at a 4 percent conversion rate.
evals.expected_output: Requests spend, conversion value, variable costs, attribution window, and assumptions before calculating break-even economics.
